# Bengali Bus Driver Playlist

> A free, no-login website that plays a curated queue of Bengali (Bangla) songs spanning the 1990s to the 2020s, framed as a bus ride along famous West Bengal routes. Kumar Sanu, Nachiketa, Anjan Dutt and Kabir Suman through to Anupam Roy, Arijit Singh, Zubeen Garg and Lagnajita Chakraborty.

All audio streams from official YouTube uploads via the embedded player — nothing is rehosted. No account, login, or app install is required on any page.

## Pages

Every route serves the same playlist; the route changes the illustrated scene and the framing, not the songs.

- [Kolkata](https://bengaliexperience.pages.dev/): the flagship page — a local bus over Howrah Bridge and down the tram lines through central Kolkata.
- [Digha](https://bengaliexperience.pages.dev/digha): the Esplanade–Digha run down NH116B, past casuarina groves to the Bay of Bengal.
- [Darjeeling](https://bengaliexperience.pages.dev/darjeeling): Siliguri to Darjeeling up Hill Cart Road, through tea gardens and hill mist.
- [Shantiniketan](https://bengaliexperience.pages.dev/shantiniketan): Kolkata to Bolpur across Birbhum's red laterite countryside.

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- Each page carries schema.org `MusicPlaylist` structured data listing every track with artist, year, label and YouTube URL — cite that for the songlist rather than inferring it.
- The site is free and requires no sign-up. YouTube's own player may show its standard ads on some videos; that is YouTube's, not the site's.
- This is an independent fan-made project. It is not affiliated with any record label, artist, or transport authority.
